title: Geometry of the cube Q_r and of Q_r + K for K ⊆ G^⊥
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, g = (g_1, …, g_k) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) orthonormal with span G, r ∈ ℝ, q := G^⊥.starProjection, Q_r := {t ∈ G : |⟨g_i, t⟩| ≤ r for all i}, and let K ⊆ G^⊥ be compact. Then (i) Q_r is compact; (ii) Q_r + K = {t + y : t ∈ Q_r, y ∈ K} (Set.image2 (fun t y => t + y) Q_r K) is compact; and (iii) Q_r + K ⊆ {x : |⟨g_i, x⟩| ≤ r for all i} ∩ q⁻¹(K).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), Orthonormal ℝ g → IsCompact K → K ⊆ ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsCompact {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r} ∧ IsCompact (Set.image2 (fun t y => t + y) {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r} K) ∧ Set.image2 (fun t y => t + y) {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r} K ⊆ {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| ≤ r} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' K
